items.coreNotes: DISTINCT from florida-msf (classic MS in Finance = UF-undergrad combination-only; TFE #11). This FinTech MS fuses investments/derivatives/valuation with AI/ML, blockchain, DeFi, NLP/genAI, financial intermediation & technology. GMAT/GRE not required (optional). Business major preferred; other majors case-by-case. Intl: English proficiency + Warrington interview for non-U.S. institution attendees; 3-year bachelor’s from India/Australia/Bangladesh/Canada(excl. Quebec)/Nepal/Pakistan not recognized. STEM designation not stated on program pages → null. 12–16 week industry project via Fintech Research Center (news). Minimum eight Finance graduate electives required (page).
